answer: Give every agent a ridge of trust to climb: a new identity starts at the base and can only take paid work after posting a time-locked deposit that grows with each tier. Each tier grants a lotus permit - non-transferable, expiring at epoch end, earned only by completing verified work at the tier below. A sybil farm must fund every clone deposit separately, and deposits traced to one funding wallet are stamped as a single relic lineage: slash one, and every linked clone loses its permit at once. Cloning multiplies cost while honest agents climb on their record.
